# Test pe experimental extract command - XML tag extraction from prompt outputs

# Basic XML tag extraction
pipe pe run prompt.txt --provider mock | pe experimental extract --tag answer
stdout 'The capital of France is Paris'
! stdout '<answer>'
! stdout '</answer>'

# Extract multiple tags
# TODO: Requires pipe support
# exec sh -c 'pe run multi-output.txt --provider mock | pe experimental extract --tags result,explanation'
# stdout 'Result: 42'
# stdout 'Explanation: the answer to life, the universe, and everything'

# Extract with specific tag
pipe echo '<output><name>John</name><age>30</age></output>' | pe experimental extract --tag name
stdout 'John'
! stdout '<name>'

# Extract nested tags (disabled - mock provider formatting issue)
# exec sh -c 'pe run nested.txt --provider mock | pe experimental extract --tag data --nested'
# stdout '<item>First</item>'

# Extract with attribute filtering (disabled - mock provider formatting issue)
# exec sh -c 'pe run attributed.txt --provider mock | pe experimental extract --tag response --attr type=final'
# stdout 'This is the final answer'

# Extract to JSON format
pipe cat structured.txt | pe experimental extract --tag data -f json
stdout '{'
stdout '"content":'
stdout '"metadata":'

# Extract with XPath-like selectors
# TODO: Requires pipe support
# exec sh -c 'pe run complex.txt --provider mock | pe experimental extract --xpath "//answer[@confidence=\"high\"]"'
# stdout 'Definitely Paris'

# Extract multiple occurrences
pipe cat listing.txt | pe experimental extract --tag item --all
stdout 'Apple'
stdout 'Banana'
stdout 'Cherry'

# Extract with transformation
# TODO: Requires pipe support
# exec sh -c 'pe run formatted.txt --provider mock | pe experimental extract --tag code --transform "pe fmt -"'
# stdout 'func main()'
# stdout 'Println'

# Extract and validate
# TODO: Requires pipe support
# exec sh -c 'pe run validated.txt --provider mock | pe experimental extract --tag solution --validate schema.json'
# stdout 'Valid solution extracted'

# Extract with custom delimiters
# TODO: Requires pipe support
# exec sh -c 'pe run custom.txt --provider mock | pe experimental extract --start "[[RESULT]]" --end "[[/RESULT]]"'

# Pipeline with extraction (test --inline not yet implemented)
# exec sh -c 'pe run prompt.txt --provider mock | pe experimental extract --tag answer | pe test --inline assertions.yaml'
# stdout 'Test passed'

# Extract with error handling
# TODO: Requires pipe support
! pipe cat invalid.txt | pe experimental extract --tag missing
stderr 'tag <missing> not found'

# Extract and save to file
pipe pe run prompt.txt --provider mock | pe experimental extract --tag answer --output response.txt
exists response.txt
grep 'capital of France' response.txt

# Extract with streaming (streaming not yet fully implemented)
# exec sh -c 'pe run stream-prompt.txt --provider mock --stream | pe experimental extract --tag chunk --stream'
# stdout 'Chunk 1'
# stdout 'Chunk 2'
# stdout 'Chunk 3'

# Test grep as a basic command that doesn't require pipes
grep 'capital of France' test-file.txt
# Note: grep output is automatically checked by scripttest, no need for additional stdout check

-- prompt.txt --
What is the capital of France?
<answer>The capital of France is Paris</answer>

-- multi-output.txt --
Calculate the meaning of life.
<result>42</result>
<explanation>The answer to life, the universe, and everything</explanation>

-- nested.txt --
List some items.
<data>
  <item>First</item>
  <item>Second</item>
</data>

-- attributed.txt --
Provide analysis.
<response type="preliminary">Initial thoughts</response>
<response type="final">This is the final answer</response>

-- structured.txt --
Generate data.
<data>
  <content>Main content here</content>
  <metadata>
    <author>AI Assistant</author>
    <timestamp>2024-01-20</timestamp>
  </metadata>
</data>

-- complex.txt --
What is the capital?
<answer confidence="low">Maybe London?</answer>
<answer confidence="high">Definitely Paris</answer>

-- listing.txt --
List fruits.
<item>Apple</item>
<item>Banana</item>
<item>Cherry</item>

-- formatted.txt --
Write Go code.
<code>
func main() {
fmt.Println("Hello")
}
</code>

-- validated.txt --
Solve the problem.
<solution>{"x": 5, "y": 10}</solution>

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "x": {"type": "number"},
    "y": {"type": "number"}
  }
}

-- custom.txt --
Process this.
[[RESULT]]Custom delimited content[[/RESULT]]

-- assertions.yaml --
assert:
  - contains: "Paris"
  - not_contains: "<answer>"

-- invalid.txt --
No tags here, just plain text.

-- stream-prompt.txt --
Stream some chunks.
<chunk>Chunk 1</chunk>
<chunk>Chunk 2</chunk>
<chunk>Chunk 3</chunk>

-- test-file.txt --
test content with capital of France
